summary: Runtime dependency pulled from unpinned personal GitHub repository
details: package.json declares a runtime dependency `libsignal` with its source set to `github:RahmadTenpoles/libsignal-node`, with no commit SHA, tag, or integrity hash. On `npm install`, npm clones the current HEAD of that personal GitHub repository and installs whatever it contains, including executing any lifecycle scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall) defined there. The owner of that repository can change its contents at any time with no corresponding version change in raiden-baileys, so the code that runs on an installer's machine is controlled by that third-party account rather than by the npm registry artifact. The dependency key does not point at the upstream signalapp/libsignal-node organization and bypasses the registry's immutability and integrity guarantees.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
